overview: Built an inbound voice and appointment automation system for a car rental client using GoHighLevel and Synthflow.
The system handles incoming customer calls, manages appointment bookings, updates contact records, and sends appointment confirmation emails automatically.

blocks.p: Configured a dedicated inbound voice agent in Synthflow for handling incoming calls.
The agent connects with the GoHighLevel subaccount and supports the appointment booking process.

These workflows keep customer information and call outcomes organized inside the CRM.
When an appointment is booked, the system updates the contact record and triggers the required follow up process.
Appointment information is used to prepare the confirmation communication automatically.

The communication is recorded within the customer’s CRM record.

result: A complete inbound appointment system connecting voice calls, lead capture, CRM updates, appointment booking, and email confirmations in one workflow.
This reduces manual follow up work and keeps the entire appointment process organized inside GoHighLevel.
